en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 452 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Abi Umair from Umar bin Uziyana from Muhammad bin Muslim that he said:

I heard His Eminence, Abu Abdullah Sadiq (a.s) say: “After the Sufyani gets control over five provinces he would rule equal to the duration of pregnancy of a woman.” Then he said: “I seek forgiveness of Allah, he would rule for the duration of pregnancy of a camel. And his matter is inevitable.”
